scientific_integrity: The algebraic classification is proved for every finite m>=2. Finite exhaustive computation confirms m<=4 and recurrence counts m<=8, but does not prove all-m cases. Independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Classification concerns finite powerset Boolean algebras under the full permutation group, not all arbitrary preconditionals, and the recurrence is exact rather than a closed form. Earlier equivalent priority remains a risk.
title: Permutation-equivariant fundamental preconditionals on finite Boolean algebras
